evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphoristic framing carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is declared equivalent to no rollback at all, compressing operational risk into a pointed alarm.
